title: Text Editor
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: TEXT EDITOR
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, exact-length zero end; exact left/right timing match; runtime untested
versions.startupSource:
1 CLS
2 DIM T(100,1)
3 CLEAR6000
5 X=0:Y=0:DEFSTRT
10 A$=INKEY$:IFA$="@"THEN200ELSEPRINTA$;:GOSUB100:GOTO10
100 IF(LEN(T(X,Y))>56ANDA$=" ")ORA$=CHR$(13)THEN150ELSET(X,Y)=T(X,Y)+A$
110 IFLEN(T(X,Y))>61THENT(X,Y)=T(X,Y)+"-":GOTO150
130 GOTO160
150 X=X+1
160 RETURN
200 PRINT:PRINT"YOU MAY (PRINT) OR (RELINE) OR (CRUISE)"
210 INPUT"WHICH SHALL IT BE (FIRST LETTER)";A$

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
